site_settings.intro: We are a CBO in Kilifi, Kenya that advocates for Health, Gender, Peace and Security, Climate Change and Disability Inclusion for a healthy and safe Kilifi County.
site_settings.about: We are the catalysts for change, tirelessly working towards a world liberated from the shackles of gender-based violence. We champion comprehensive sexual health education, sow the seeds of lasting peace and security, and engineer sustainable solutions to combat the looming threat of climate change. Join us in the pursuit of a transformed world, where lives flourish, ignorance dissipates, and a harmonious future becomes our shared reality.
site_settings.mission: To empower vulnerable and marginalized groups in the community
site_settings.vision: To empower vulnerable and marginalized groups in the community
site_settings.donation_campaign: Fund 1,000 more young people this year
site_settings.work_intro: Timiza Youth Initiative, a Community Based Organization (CBO) established in 2021 by a group of young volunteers, focuses on addressing the needs of vulnerable and marginalized groups in Kilifi County. Guided by a human-centered design approach, the organization is committed to finding innovative solutions to various challenges. Timiza Youth Initiative is dedicated to empowering children, young women, and youths through its core thematic programs: Health & Gender, climate change, peace & security, and disability inclusion. By prioritizing these areas, the organization aims to create positive change and opportunities for growth within the community.
site_settings.story: Timiza Youth Initiative is a Community Based Organization (CBO) formed in 2021 by a group of young volunteers. The Organization is driven by a human-centered design for solutions to problems faced by vulnerable and marginalized groups in Kilifi County. We are at the forefront to ensure children, young women, and youths get empowered through our core thematic programs including: Health & Gender, climate change, peace & security, and disability inclusion.
site_settings.goal: To empower vulnerable and marginalized groups in the community
site_settings.values:
Access to healthcare
Equity
Empowerment
Transparency and Accountability
Inclusion
site_settings.objectives:
To ensure that individuals have access to accurate and age appropriate information about sexual and reproductive health
Encourage community involvement and participation in climate action through volunteer opportunities, community activities, and citizen science initiatives
Advocating for gender equality, women's empowerment, and sexual reproductive health education
Raise community understanding of the security challenges through educating and training members on conflict prevention and resolution tactics
Promotion of education and skills enhancement among women and young people
Providing a channel of advocacy for issues affecting the communities
Inclusion and equal participation of people with disabilities in all aspects of society. This will include ensuring their access to education, healthcare, transportation, and other essential services.

site_stories.title: Peer educators bring SRH information to Mtwapa market
site_stories.stat_label: young people reached in one day
site_stories.summary: A market-day outreach reached more young people than any event this year.
site_stories.body: Traders' children and boda riders rarely come to youth centres, so the team went to them. Twelve peer educators ran a health desk, quiz and health quiz through the market day.
site_stories.quote: I learned more in ten minutes at the stand than in school.

site_stories.title: Watamu boda riders join the GBV referral network
site_stories.summary: A ward dialogue ended with the boda association agreeing to help survivors reach support.
site_stories.body: Riders are often the first people a survivor calls for transport. After the dialogue, the association agreed to carry the referral hotline and take survivors to the nearest service free of charge.
site_stories.quote: We move people every day. Now we know where to take them.

site_stories.title: 3,450 indigenous trees in the ground before the rains
site_stories.summary: Schools, volunteers and the county planted at four sites from Kilifi creek to Kaloleni.
site_stories.body: Each site has a school climate club responsible for watering and counting survivors every month.
site_stories.quote: Our club checks the trees every Friday.
